behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Multiple original-coordinate hunks with length changes and inverse restoring original lines.
Later context conflict does not mutate input lines/hunks.
docDelivery: Original coordinate and nonoverlap rules, same-position insertions and exact context checks.
Inverse addresses resulting lines; adjacent deletion handling and failure/ownership guarantees.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Dense arrays of up to10000 lines; each line string excludes CR/LF but may be empty/Unicode. Hunks exact {at,remove,insert}; line arrays valid, invalid at/order/content included. Positions refer original input. Both source and final result <=10000 lines; larger-result calls outside domain.
independence: Implement line-based patch application with context matching, conflict rejection and inverse restoration.
